Gracie is a media solutions expert at Deloitte, specializing in commerce media networks and performance advertising to drive revenue for Retail and Consumer brands.

Her knowledge of advertising technology and direct experience in the media landscape help brands to drive customer acquisition and retention. She leads both strategy and technology teams to enhance client advertising systems to unlock new revenue streams.
